final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 THEN HGB / HCT END) AS ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), cross_patient AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - c.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess_ratio FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN cross_patient AS c WHERE p.ratio > c.avg_ratio
